# `security-requirement-removed`

Less auth required

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `security-requirement-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Security ([RULES.md section 3](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An operation needs less authentication: no security at all, an optional empty requirement (`{}`) was added, or a scheme was dropped from a combined requirement.

## Why this default

Clients that send credentials keep working.

## Example

From test case [`security-requirement-removed`](../../test/cases/security-requirement-removed/): Auth no longer required.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
      get:
        operationId: listPets
-       security:
-       - apiKey: []
+       security: []
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `security-requirement-removed` · info · GET /pets
